subject: Neptune Systems + Redwood co-sell demo coordination and rehearsal
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@neptune-systems.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.r@neptune-systems.com>
Date: 2027-10-11T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Quick ask — co-sell walkthrough & marketplace demo availability

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for the intro last month — Neptune is excited to move to a joint customer demo that showcases the Redwood inference runtime + our SI services and the upcoming AWS Marketplace listing. Do you have availability for a technical co-sell demo the week of Oct 14? Ideally we'd do a 45–60 minute session: 30 minutes demo + 15–30 minutes Q&A and GTM next steps.

High-level goals:
- Show Redwood latency/cost profile on a 3rd-party benchmark
- Walk through Neptune's integration + deployment model
- Confirm Marketplace SKU and listing owners for go-live notes

I've attached a short integration diagram and our preferred attendee list. Primary attendees on our side: me (product), Priya (partnerships), and an AWS marketplace contact (TBD).

Proposed times (PT):
- Thu Oct 14, 9:00–10:00am PT
- Thu Oct 14, 1:00–2:00pm PT
- Fri Oct 15, 10:00–11:00am PT

If those don't work, happy to propose other windows.

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Senior Partnerships Manager
Neptune Systems
Attachments: Neptune_Integration_SLA.pdf
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@neptune-systems.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-11T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — co-sell walkthrough & marketplace demo availability

Hi Alex — great to hear, and the diagram looks helpful. We're keen to present a joint demo and to align Marketplace owners before you go live.

We can do Thu Oct 14. Our team availability (PT):
- 9:00–10:00am PT — vanessa (GTM) + marcus (tech lead)
- 1:00–2:00pm PT — vanessa + karthik (marketplace & partner ops)

Marcus and Karthik, would you prefer the morning slot (more technical) or the afternoon (more marketplace + GTM)?

Next steps:
1) Alex — can you confirm final attendee list (names + roles)?
2) We'll send a calendar invite once time is confirmed and attach a short rehearsal checklist.
3) Recommend a 30–45 minute internal rehearsal the day before for run-of-show and screen-share verification.

Looking forward to it.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: marcus_lin@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-10-11T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — co-sell walkthrough & marketplace demo availability

Vanessa — quick note from the infra side:
- Morning slot (9:00am PT) works better for a deep technical demo — I can cover throughput, model pinning, and the dedicated fallback flow.
- Karthik, if you can take the 1:00pm slot for marketplace details, that splits responsibilities cleanly.

Also: prefer the rehearsal on Wed Oct 13 at 11:00am PT. I'll bring the runbook and a short artifact with expected token/perf numbers.

Marcus Lin
Principal Engineer, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@neptune-systems.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
Cc: Priya Ramesh <priya.r@neptune-systems.com>, marketplace@amazonaws.com
Date: 2027-10-12T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — co-sell walkthrough & marketplace demo availability

Thanks Vanessa & Marcus — morning slot confirmed on our end. Final attendee list from Neptune:
- Alex Chen (Product Partnerships)
- Priya Ramesh (Partnerships)
- Rahul Mehta (Solutions Architect) — will join for the technical Q&A

I've looped AWS Marketplace (marketplace@amazonaws.com) to confirm their availability — they asked for the SKU name and a short list of marketplace questions to prep.

We'll plan Thu Oct 14, 9:00–10:00am PT. Please send calendar invite and rehearsal time. We can also do a quick 15-minute pre-demo call at 8:40am PT to test audio if folks prefer.

Attachments: CoSell-Rehearsal-Checklist.docx

Best,
Alex
From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@neptune-systems.com>
Cc: marcus_lin@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marketplace@amazonaws.com
Date: 2027-10-13T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick ask — co-sell walkthrough & marketplace demo availability

All — confirmed: Thu Oct 14, 9:00–10:00am PT. Calendar invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=neptune-demo-20271014 (please accept).

Rehearsal: Wed Oct 13, 11:00–11:30am PT (internal only) — agenda attached in the CoSell-Rehearsal-Checklist.docx. Marcus will handle demo run-of-show, Rahul (Neptune) and Marcus will do the opening technical walkthrough. Karthik will present the SKU/listing owners and GTM cadence in the last 10 minutes.

Ask for AWS Marketplace team: please bring a short checklist of listing requirements (billing, metering, support contact). If you can drop that in this thread or upload to the Atlassian ticket (MD-221), that will help us finalize pre-reqs.

Vanessa Ortiz
